subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Should image, image-generation, and PDF remote media loads fail after 15 minutes without response headers?
rationale: The implementation is technically correct and preserves healthy streaming bodies, but selecting a fixed deadline intentionally changes behavior for exceptionally slow existing upstreams.

options.title: Accept 15-minute ceiling
options.body: Merge the header-only deadline so indefinite pre-header stalls terminate while body streaming retains its separate idle-gap timeout.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Pause until shared-media owners select a different fixed response-header limit for agent tools.

recommendation.title: Accept 15-minute ceiling
recommendation.body: Merge the header-only deadline so indefinite pre-header stalls terminate while body streaming retains its separate idle-gap timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the dominant current owner of the affected paths and merged the canonical shared timeout implementation.
